entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A Phyrexian newt sleeper agent who rebelled against Phyrexia, befriended Urza, and sacrificed herself at Koilos.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who sought revenge on the Phyrexians for assimilating his brother and was rescued by and traveled with Xantcha.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: A slave who looked like Mishra, freed by Xantcha and sent to help Urza; he died with her at Koilos.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor and Inner Circle member who oversaw Xantcha's group and later fought Urza at Koilos.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The ruler of Phyrexia who controlled all the sleeper agents and assaulted Urza's mind.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, assimilated by the Phyrexians; some of his flesh may have been used to create Xantcha.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker who healed Urza in her realm using white mana.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Urza's silver golem, whose personality core was Xantcha's Phyrexian Heartstone.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A character who opened the Starfield Orb left by Urza in 4562 AR.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The artificial plane of Yawgmoth, composed of Spheres, which planned to invade Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Phyrexia intended to invade and where Urza and Xantcha later lived.

entities.name: Moag
entities.description: A plane where Urza and Xantcha settled for several decades.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: The realm where Serra healed Urza.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: The place where Urza fought Gix to the death.

entities.name: Fane of Flesh
entities.description: A place on the Fourth Sphere of Phyrexia where Xantcha and hundreds of newts were created.

entities.name: Urza's Assault on Phyrexia
entities.description: Urza's attack on Phyrexia in his dragon engine, which was halted after he breached the first four Spheres.

entities.name: Gulmany
entities.description: A place where Urza and Xantcha stayed in a cabin.

entities.name: Starfield Orb
entities.description: An orb left by Urza containing a pocket dimension of his cabin, with plans and constructs.

events.summary: Xantcha is created at the Fane of Flesh as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
events.quote: The Fane of Flesh on the Fourth Sphere of Phyrexia was where Xantcha and several other hundreds of newts of her pod were created.

events.summary: Xantcha is sent to the First Sphere to be taught how to survive on her target plane; she begins to think for herself.
Xantcha meets Gix, receives her name and chooses a female identity as rebellion; he fails to break her mind.
events.quote: Xantcha thus had gained both her name and her gender from her first meeting with Gix.

events.summary: The first newts are found out and killed by Dominaria's inhabitants, and assignments stop; Xantcha is forgotten.
events.quote: Xantcha, largely forgotten, waited for an assignment that never came.

events.summary: The Shard of Twelve Worlds closes Phyrexia off from Dominaria, and Yawgmoth harshly punishes Gix as Xantcha watches.
events.quote: For this oversight, Gix was harshly punished by Yawgmoth with a grand display that Xantcha personally observed.

events.summary: Xantcha betrays Phyrexia while working as a relic seeker, destroying or booby-trapping artifacts.
events.quote: she usurped her role by destroying or booby-trapping the artifacts instead.

events.summary: Urza rescues Xantcha from Phyrexian executioners and she tells him how to reach Phyrexia.
events.quote: He rescued Xantcha from her executioners and, in return, Xantcha told Urza how to get to Phyrexia.

events.summary: Urza attacks the returned Phyrexians and follows them home, beginning his Assault on Phyrexia.
events.quote: Urza attacked, and followed the fleeing Phyrexians to their home plane, starting Urza's Assault on Phyrexia .

events.summary: Yawgmoth halts Urza and assaults his mind; Xantcha gets her life matrix, shakes Urza from his stupor and he planeswalks them away.
events.quote: he planeswalked them away to safety.

events.summary: Urza and Xantcha settle on Moag for decades until Xantcha finds oil in a temple and Urza destroys it.
events.quote: Urza blasted the temple, destroying most of the Phyrexians

events.summary: Serra heals Urza at Serra's Realm; Phyrexians track them down and they escape to Dominaria.
events.quote: Urza and Xantcha planeswalked to Dominaria, escaping the destruction.

events.summary: Xantcha frees Ratepe and sends him to help Urza regain his sanity.
events.quote: She found a slave that looked like Mishra (named Ratepe ) and paid for his freedom.

events.summary: Xantcha discovers the praetor Gix in a crypt while planting screaming spiders against sleeper agents.
events.quote: she went into a crypt where she discovered the praetor Gix.

events.summary: Urza and Gix fight at Koilos; Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves, letting Urza defeat Gix.
events.quote: The disruption made Gix pause and gave Urza the chance to defeat him.

events.summary: Urza later uses Xantcha's Phyrexian Heartstone as the personality core of Karn.
events.quote: Urza would later use Xantcha's Phyrexian Heartstone as the personality core for his silver golem Karn .

events.summary: In 4562 AR Jodah opens the Starfield Orb and is greeted by constructs of Xantcha and Mishra.
events.quote: In 4562 AR, Jodah opened the Starfield Orb left by Urza.

relations.quote: Overseeing Xantcha's group was the Inner Circle member Gix

relations.note: Created as a sleeper agent controlled by him, though she rebelled.
relations.quote: Yawgmoth , the Ineffable, controlled all the sleeper agents
instead developing a close relationship with Urza

relations.note: They fought to the death at Koilos.
relations.quote: Urza followed the praetor and they fought to the death.

relations.note: She took him in and he died with her.
relations.quote: was responsible for taking in their companion Ratepe
the planeswalker Serra used her white-mana magic to heal Urza at the risk of her own life.
